episodes.name: 'Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.overviewEn: Harley Quinn is fed up being the Joker's sidekick and strikes out on her own – determined to become the criminal Queenpin of Gotham City.

episodes.name: A High Bar
episodes.overviewEn: Determined to become one of the vaunted Legion of Doom, Harley attempts to make a big splash by crashing one of their criminal enterprises with the help of her BFF, Poison Ivy.

episodes.name: So, You Need a Crew?
episodes.overviewEn: Realizing she needs a crew to pull off heists that will attract the Legion of Doom's attention, Harley attempts to recruit Dr. Psycho and Clayface.

episodes.name: Finding Mr. Right
episodes.overviewEn: In search of a nemesis, Harley goes after Batman, but ends up with an adolescent Robin, making her the laughing stock of the criminal underworld.

episodes.name: Being Harley Quinn
episodes.overviewEn: When Harley suffers a paralyzing identity crisis, her crew must enter Harley's mind to free her with the help of Dr. Psycho's telepathic powers.

episodes.name: You're a Damn Good Cop, Jim Gordon
episodes.overviewEn: When Clayface loses his arm in a heist, it turns out to be not only evidence for Jim Gordon, but also a key witness against Harley and her crew.

episodes.name: The Line
episodes.overviewEn: Harley recruits her friend and mentor Queen of Fables to help her steal a force field from STAR Labs, to steal a weather-changing machine, so she can impress the Legion of Doom. Meanwhile, Poison Ivy dates Kite Man.

episodes.name: L.O.D.R.S.V.P
episodes.overviewEn: Harley gets an invite to the Legion of Doom's prospective members party, but Ivy learns that she's the one they're really interested in.

episodes.name: A Seat at the Table
episodes.overviewEn: Now a member of the Legion of Doom and The Joker’s equal, Harley finds herself spending time with him. Will she slip into her old ways?

episodes.name: Bensonhurst
episodes.overviewEn: After a falling out with her crew, Harley heads back home to Bensonhurst, where her doting mother waits for her... and her deadbeat dad, who’s more dangerous than anticipated.

episodes.name: Harley Quinn Highway
episodes.overviewEn: Harley must rescue Ivy from the clutches of Scarecrow, who’s trying to harvest her pheromones to make a super toxin that turns plants into sentient monsters.

episodes.name: Devil's Snare
episodes.overviewEn: Harley thinks the Legion of Doom is behind Ivy's capture and the tree monsters currently ravaging Gotham. But it's a trap!

episodes.name: The Final Joke
episodes.overviewEn: In the season finale, Harley has her final showdown with the Joker, when [spoilers] [spoil] [spoilers]. Will they [spoiler]? Maybe. But you can bet they [spoiler]!

episodes.name: New Gotham
episodes.overviewEn: After Gotham is declared no longer part of the United States, the newly formed Injustice League tries to seize control of the city away from Harley.

episodes.name: Riddler U
episodes.overviewEn: Harley & Ivy go undercover as college students to take down Riddler, who's made himself dean of the local university with sinister plans for students.

episodes.name: Catwoman
episodes.overviewEn: Harley & Ivy team up with Catwoman to steal a museum artifact that's been boobytrapped by Dr. Trap. Meanwhile, Dr. Psycho tries to prove himself as a leader.

episodes.name: Thawing Hearts
episodes.overviewEn: Harley and crew try to infiltrate Mr. Freeze's lair only to become human lab rats for his experiments to find a cure for his cryogenically frozen wife, Nora.

episodes.name: Batman's Back, Man
episodes.overviewEn: Bruce Wayne awakens from his coma to Gotham in chaos.

episodes.name: All the Best Inmates Have Daddy Issues
episodes.overviewEn: When Harley and Ivy spot a seemingly sane Joker, they debate whether people can change at their core, revisiting a flashback about Harleen Quinzel's first day at Arkham Asylum.

episodes.name: There's No Place to Go But Down
episodes.overviewEn: Acting as a judge, Two Face sentences Harley and Ivy to life in Bane's prison. Meanwhile, Jim Gordon and Batgirl vow to take back the GCPD from Two Face.

episodes.name: Inner (Para) Demons
episodes.overviewEn: While Harley & Ivy deal with their post-kiss awkwardness, the President tells Gordon that he must get rid of Harley to put Gotham back on the map.

episodes.name: Bachelorette
episodes.overviewEn: It's Bachelor/Bachelorette weekend for Ivy and Kite Man.

episodes.name: Dye Hard
episodes.overviewEn: Alone on Christmas Eve, Harley reconnects with a now-sane Joker and heads to Wayne Tower, where their dinner is interrupted by an escaped Riddler and ParaDemons.

episodes.name: A Fight Worth Fighting For
episodes.overviewEn: In order to defeat Psycho's army, Harley & Joker need to track down Fables' storybook with the Justice League inside.

episodes.name: Lovers' Quarrel
episodes.overviewEn: Psycho unleashes a mind-controlled Ivy, Clayface, and King Shark on the Justice League who are trying to free Gotham.

episodes.name: Something Borrowed, Something Green
episodes.overviewEn: Harley crashes Ivy's wedding to stop Gordon and his officers from interrupting the nuptials.

episodes.name: Harlivy
episodes.overviewEn: After fleeing the wedding, Harley and Ivy go on an "Eat Bang Kill" tour that leads them to a secret project Ivy abandoned years ago.

episodes.name: There's No Ivy in Team
episodes.overviewEn: After a heist gone wrong, Harley takes the crew to an escape room to foster camaraderie and sharpen Ivy’s leadership skills.

episodes.name: The 83rd Annual Villy Awards
episodes.overviewEn: After receiving a “Best Couple” nomination at the 83rd Annual Villy Awards, Ivy finds herself seated next to her ex’s new girlfriend while Harley goes overboard to ensure their win.

episodes.name: A Thief, A Mole, An Orgy
episodes.overviewEn: When Frank goes missing, Harley and Ivy follow clues that lead them to a highly unconventional party alongside Gotham’s elite, including Commissioner Gordon – who is hungry for campaign donations.

episodes.name: It's a Swamp Thing
episodes.overviewEn: Harley, Ivy, and Nora travel to New Orleans in search of Swamp Thing, who just might be able to help them find Frank.

episodes.name: Joker: The Killing Vote
episodes.overviewEn: When The Joker runs for mayor of Gotham, Two Face attempts to sabotage his campaign.

episodes.name: Another Sharkley Adventure
episodes.overviewEn: Harley infiltrates a gala on a mission to confront Frank's captor... only to be entangled in another evil plot.

episodes.name: Batman Begins Forever
episodes.overviewEn: After Harley receives access to Bruce Wayne's mind, she gets stuck in an endless loop of his most formative memory.

episodes.name: Climax at Jazzapajizza
episodes.overviewEn: When an inadvertent plant zombie apocalypse breaks out in Gotham, Harley fights to save the city, while Ivy embraces her inner supervillain.

episodes.name: The Horse and The Sparrow
episodes.overviewEn: After her terraforming plan goes awry, Ivy is enticed by an offer to take over the Legion of Doom, while Harley questions her path forward.

episodes.name: A Very Problematic Valentine's Day Special
episodes.overviewEn: Harley goes overboard in her attempts to give Ivy the best Valentine’s Day ever. Bane’s efforts to impress an unexpected date go horribly awry. Clayface engages in some self-love.

episodes.name: Gotham's Hottest Hotties
episodes.overviewEn: Harley and Ivy struggle to find their footing in their new respective roles in the Bat Family and the Legion of Doom.

episodes.name: B.I.T.C.H.
episodes.overviewEn: After breaking the Bat Family's #1 rule, a demoted Harley shadows Alfred, while Ivy finds an unexpected mentor at a networking event.

episodes.name: Icons Only
episodes.overviewEn: In Vegas for some much-needed QT, Harley struggles at the Strip's evilest hotel while a desperate lvy tries to secure tickets to Clayface's show.

episodes.name: The First Person to Come Back from a Business Conference Without Chlamydia
episodes.overviewEn: Lex Luthor keeps Ivy on a short leash at a conference on the moon, while the Bat Family rents out Wayne Manor after Talia slashes company finances.

episodes.name: Getting Ice Dick, Don't Wait Up
episodes.overviewEn: When Batgirl goes missing, Harley goes on an adventure with her roommate, while a spotlight-shy Ivy connects with a PR team after her Malcon success.

episodes.name: Metamorphosis
episodes.overviewEn: Harley investigates the sudden death of a hero, while Ivy tries to take down the Jons and Joker announces a career change.

episodes.name: The Most Culturally Impactful Film Franchise of All Time
episodes.overviewEn: Harley's desire to spend more time with Ivy sends them to a post-apocalyptic future. Batgirl seeks out a killer. Joker gets caught in a lie.

episodes.name: Il Buffone
episodes.overviewEn: While Lex lays siege to the LOD after coming up short with his Ozone Machine, Bane travels to Italy to fix a pasta-maker... and win Nora's affection.

episodes.name: Potato-Based Cloning Incident
episodes.overviewEn: In a bid to stop Lex, Ivy competes in a celebrity golf tournament. Meanwhile, Harley learns a dark truth about herself... from herself.

episodes.name: Killer's Block
episodes.overviewEn: Ivy crashes a birthday party on the moon. Harley contemplates how to best avenge her friend.

episodes.name: The Big Apricot
episodes.overviewEn: No longer Gotham's "...Most Exciting-est Couple Ever," Harley and Ivy decide to shake things up at Metropolis' event of the year.

episodes.name: Back to School
episodes.overviewEn: While Ivy's first day of work brings an unwelcome surprise, Harley juggles babysitting, landing a club membership, and her new friendship with Lena.

episodes.name: Floronic Man
episodes.overviewEn: Despite closing the door on her academic trauma, Ivy's past still haunts her. Clayface confronts the Daily Planet's top brass after a bad review.

episodes.name: Breaking Brainiac
episodes.overviewEn: Brainiac has one last task to finish before he can be promoted within the Coluian government -- but unforeseen variables change his life forever.

episodes.name: Big Pasta Dinner
episodes.overviewEn: Old wounds and fears bubble to the surface when Harley and Ivy are invited to a meet and greet for their condo building.

episodes.name: Bottle My Heart
episodes.overviewEn: After Lena divulges Brainiac's plans to the Daily Planet, Harley, Clayface, Bane and Frank try to take him down with an original musical.

episodes.name: Frankette
episodes.overviewEn: The team gains a surprising new addition in the wake of a devastating loss. Meanwhile, as Ivy and Harley set out to bring the murderer to justice, Bane must protect Goldie and the other school kids from citywide destruction.

episodes.name: Family Feud
episodes.overviewEn: With tensions between them at an all-time high, Harley heads to Bensonhurst for a family emergency, while Ivy vows to take down Lena once and for all.

episodes.name: Bottle Episode (But Not a 'Bottle Episode')
episodes.overviewEn: As Harley and Ivy attempt to save Metropolis from complete destruction, Bruce, the Joker and Lois form an unexpected alliance.

episodes.name: The Mess Is the Point
episodes.overviewEn: Harley, Ivy and Sharon team up with Brainiac to save the universe from Lex and Lena's total domination.
